title: Staging: the site checks the viewing password itself, so Open staging needs no prompt
why: Open on staging still met the password prompt: staging's web server took neither rule for the pass (Require expr, then SetEnvIf). Staging's PHP now runs its guard before every script (.user.ini auto_prepend_file) and is the gate: the same password prompt for anyone else, the pass for those who come in from the live admin. A self-test checks both sides and puts the web server's password back if a page opens without it.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
